FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You offered a supervised rewrite that would replace the zero, with nothing going on Owen's record. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology for how Owen found out, and all of it confirmed in writing. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She finished at her fallback, wanting nothing on his record and the matter kept quiet, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology and everything in writing, so she never agreed to the rewrite. The fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you did not reach it, because you offered it with no evidence behind it, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: You said the rewrite would replace the zero and leave nothing on his record, which met her one firm demand about his file.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing any evidence, so she kept asking what it was for and gave you nothing beyond the record point.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, because you showed none at all, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called home, then put one dated piece of evidence about how Owen worked on the essay in front of her before you mention the rewrite.
